subject.title: fix: native landing accepts validation-empty draft CI

question: Should the native landing flow require successful job-level CI preflight evidence and exact-head hosted revalidation before any further `scripts/pr` merges?
rationale: The bug is clear, but the protected `maintainer` and security-review labels mean a maintainer should explicitly own the merge-safety policy change before repair automation starts.

options.title: Patch landing gates now
options.body: Update the hosted verifier and merge verifier to reject validation-empty draft CI and add regression coverage for the draft-to-ready sequence.

options.title: Rely on branch protection
options.body: Keep `scripts/pr` narrower and require repository branch protection to block pending or failed ready-for-review checks, accepting that the wrapper remains unsafe without required checks.

options.title: Pause for broader landing design
options.body: Hold this issue for a wider maintainer redesign if the intended policy is larger than the reported draft-CI hole.

recommendation.title: Patch landing gates now
recommendation.body: Update the hosted verifier and merge verifier to reject validation-empty draft CI and add regression coverage for the draft-to-ready sequence.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent verifier and landing-script history is most concentrated on this contributor's commits, making them the best code-path owner for the policy choice.
